about.title: What Are Crypto Exchange Rebates?
about.subtitle: Learn how rebates work and how CryptoRebate helps you save money.
about.whatDesc: When you trade on a crypto exchange, you pay trading fees. By registering through a referral link, the exchange returns a portion of those fees — that's a rebate. Register through CryptoRebate's links to continuously enjoy this benefit.
about.step1: Register on an exchange through CryptoRebate's link
about.step2: Trade crypto as you normally would
about.step3: The exchange automatically returns part of your fees
about.step4: Rebates are deposited directly to your exchange account
about.costDesc: Absolutely not. Fees with a rebate link are identical to direct registration. Rebates are the exchange's reward mechanism for referrers and never increase your trading costs.
about.riskDesc: CryptoRebate only provides exchange information comparison and registration links. We do not provide investment advice. Crypto trading carries significant risk — please make decisions based on your own circumstances. We have referral partnerships with exchanges and earn commission when users trade through our links.
about.faq1Q: What's the difference between rebates and fee discounts?
about.faq1A: Fee discounts directly reduce your trading rate. Rebates return a portion of fees after trading. Both save you money, and some exchanges offer both.
about.faq2Q: Will rebates affect my trading experience?
about.faq2A: No. After registering through a rebate link, your trading experience is identical to direct registration with all features available.
about.faq3Q: I already have an exchange account. Can I still get rebates?
about.faq3A: Usually a new account is needed to bind the rebate relationship. Consider registering with a new email. Some exchanges support binding referral codes to existing accounts — check each exchange's rules.

disclosure.title: Affiliate Disclosure
disclosure.subtitle: CryptoRebate is committed to full transparency about our business model and partnerships.
disclosure.howWeEarnDesc: CryptoRebate earns commission through affiliate (referral) links. When users register on exchanges through links on our website and make trades, we receive a percentage of the commission from the exchange.
disclosure.noCostDesc: Registering through our referral links does not increase your trading costs in any way. The fees you pay are identical to direct registration, and may even be lower (as some exchanges provide fee discounts through referral links). Our commission is paid from the exchange's marketing budget and is never deducted from your trading fees.

disclosure.commitmentDesc: While we earn revenue through referrals, we are committed to: keeping all exchange reviews objective and honest, including analysis of both pros and cons; regularly verifying rebate rates and fee data to ensure accuracy; never recommending an exchange that is not suitable for users just for commission.
disclosure.questionsDesc: If you have any questions about our affiliate partnerships, please feel free to contact us through the website.
